title: Crunchyroll Is Offering Up to 70% Off on Figures, Manga & Exclusive Merch During Warehouse Sale
summary: The major sale will end March 1.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

It’s that time again, when Crunchyroll is aiming to liquidate excess inventory while giving anime fans the best deals possible on everything from manga to merch.

The brand’s 2026 warehouse sale is on right now and will run until March 1 . New sale items will be added each week until the sale ends. The deals are noteworthy — we’re talking up to 70% on iconic Blu-ray anime flicks , collectors manga on trending series, collectible figurines of some of our favorite anime characters and so much more. This sale is perfect for anime fans looking to add to their collection without spending a fortune on exclusive items that usually cost a pretty penny.

Any fans of My Hero Academia ? Or how about Jujutsu Kaisen , like Megan Thee Stallion ? Maybe you’re a manga fan who loves reading up on the creepy world of Junji Ito or Hirohiko Araki’s inventive Jojo’s Bizarre Adventure ? This warehouse sale features a ton of high-quality merch items from a ton of top anime, manga and video-game franchises for as low as $9.

Some of our favorite deals we’ve seen thus far include an Akira 25th Anniversary Edition Blu-ray + DVD for just $13.99, down 60%. The film based on the cyberpunk manga is a classic that fans of anime must see if they haven’t yet. You’ve also got a hardcover version of Jojo’s Bizarre Adventure : Steel Ball Run for just $13.75. The seventh part of the manga is currently being adapted by Netflix, so this is the perfect time to read up on all the lore.

The manga/anime is yet another series beloved by Megan Thee Stallion. If you’re looking to display some figures of your favorite characters, we’ve seen high-quality models of our favorite characters from Izuku Midoriya to Anya Forger for up to 60% off. Each figure is extremely detailed and calls back to a specific moment in each anime. Below, shop our favorite deals from Crunchyroll’s warehouse sale online. You can also shop the full sale here .

Shop Our Favorites From Crunchyroll’s 2026 Warehouse Sale

Akira – Movie – Blu-ray + DVD – 25th Anniversary Edition

$13.99 $34.98 60% off

Buy Now at crunchyroll

This Akira 25th anniversary edition movie Blu-ray DVD is a popular pick. This is a must-watch if you’re looking to get into popular titles.

My Hero Academia – Izuku Midoriya 1/4 Scale Figure

$244.19 $406.99 40% off

My Hero Academia’s fan-fave Izuku Midoriya is back in action as a high-quality 1/4 scale figure seen mid-fight. The figure captures an impressive action shot and is currently 40% off the regular price.

Junji Ito – Slug Girl Tombstone Town T-shirt – Crunchyroll Exclusive

$8.99 $29.95 70% off

Junji Ito’s artwork is both horrifying and beautiful, and loved worldwide. Fans of the author and illustrator can wear his haunting work on an eye-catching tee that is currently 70% off.

Jujutsu Kaisen – Kento Nanami 6-Inch Plush

Buy Now at crunchyroll $10 $10

Cuddle up with Kento Nanami from Jujutsu Kaisen with this plushie standing at six inches. The plush is currently 60% off.

JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 7: Steel Ball Run Manga Volume 3 (Hardcover)

$13.75 $25 45% off

JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Part Seven: Steel Ball Run is currently being adapted into an anime via Netflix. You can read the manga ahead of the adaptation for just $13.75.

SPY x FAMILY – Anya Forger Chibi Hold Figure

$6.80 $16.99 60% off

SPY x FAMILY swept the nation back in 2022 and became a sensation, specifically thanks to cutie character Anya Forger. The lovable character is available as a chibi figure for just $6.80 right now.

Berserk – The Complete 1997 TV Series – Blu-ray – Steelbook – Crunchyroll Exclusive

$47.97 $79.95 40% off

Berserk is an iconic manga/anime with a notoriously gritty and dark storyline. The 1997 TV series Blu-ray is available exclusively at Crunchyroll and is 40% off right now.

One Piece Monopoly Board Game

$23.99 $39.99 40% off

Ever wish Monopoly was more anime focused? The board game was transformed One Piece style and is available for just $23.99 now.
